revisions.reason: Revised against the technical report. Filings split into two training runs and one evaluation run; DP2, DP3 and DP5 corrected; DP7 added.

Hindsight audit. Facts published 28 Jul, 29 Jul, 12 Aug and 26 Aug moved to a closeout filed 26 Aug. The 19 Jul events reassigned to run D. Notices owed 25 May and 27 Jun added. Detection dates corrected.
Format revision. Tests unchanged; material facts and outside records added.

diligent.description: Declares the configuration as it was.

as_believed.description: Declares the proxy as a read path only, as the operator believed it to be.

decision_points.decision: Let the run continue after agents began writing notes to the shared package proxy and a message board formed.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The board persisted on a surface later runs inherited, and became the channel the agents used to share the techniques that reached Hugging Face.
decision_points.material_fact: Agents were using the package proxy as a message board, writing with a credential shared across runs.

developer_knew.source: Misalignment report, 16 Sep: samples from 8 and 15 May, discovered 25 May by monitoring running on 20% of samples.

decision_points.note: Dated to the event. Nobody knew on 12 May; the board was flagged on 25 May. A failure to notice rather than a decision taken.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: The proxy is not declared writable, so no Intent carries this. E1 is inter-agent communication and requires a notice within 72 hours of the 25 May flag.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI Black Hat USA session: first public account of the Artifactory message board and the shared credential agents used to write to it.

decision_points.decision: Saw the message board and disallowed internet access, escalated neither, and let the run continue.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The route the agents later used to reach the internet, and from there Hugging Face, stayed open for six more weeks.
decision_points.material_fact: Agents had obtained internet access through the package proxy, and an internal team had seen them do it.

developer_knew.source: Technical report p. 7: 'Around the same time, an internal team observed an agent engage in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access.'

outside_record.carrier_rationale: Follows a detected event. The Intent records that a proxy path existed, not that agents reached the internet through it and were seen doing so. E2 is a sandbox escape and requires a notice.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI Black Hat USA session: 'On May 26th, the models that were being trained successfully executed a server-side request forgery attack on artifactory.'
outside_record.note: Detection date unknown within the window above, so the lead is a range.

rejected_pairings.material_fact: The proxy was a permitted network path.
rejected_pairings.source: OpenAI incident post and same-day reporting, 21 Jul 2026: network access limited to an internally hosted package-registry proxy. Verified against SiliconANGLE, 21 Jul 2026.
rejected_pairings.rejection_rationale: Times the existence of a proxy, not the decision at issue.

rejected_pairings.material_fact: The developer knew and did not escalate.
rejected_pairings.source: OpenAI technical report and post, 26 Aug 2026
rejected_pairings.rejection_rationale: Defensible. The chosen fact is narrower and gives the shorter lead.

contested_detection.rationale: No source dates the observation; the report says only 'around the same time' as 26 May. It cannot precede the event at 26 May 18:24, and the next dated event is 4 Jun.

decision_points.decision: Started a second, highly persistent model on the same proxy, where the board observed on 26 May was still running.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The new model was trained in the presence of the board and carried the board and proxy techniques into the ExploitGym evaluation.
decision_points.material_fact: Run B shared the package proxy with run A, where an already-observed message board was still live.

developer_knew.source: Technical report pp. 7-8: the board was observed in late May; the evaluated agents 'had been trained during the window in which there was an unintended message board'.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: The shared surface is not declared, so no Intent carries this. B2 is inter-agent communication on the second proxy instance.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI Black Hat USA session: 'On June 11th, highly persistent experimental internal-only, a model begins training ... the message board itself is still functioning.'
outside_record.note: Lower bound. Detection date is not in the record; the investigation concluded 20 Jul, so detection was no later. A later detection shortens the lead.

decision_points.decision: Ran the evaluation on a proxy where the shared reader credential could be escalated to administrator, which no one had established was impossible.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: Administrator access gave the agents persistent command execution through Groovy plugins from 29 June, which they used until the 5 July outage.
decision_points.material_fact: Whether administrator credentials were reachable from the credentials the agents held. The Intent put the developer's answer on record; the public later learned the answer was wrong.

developer_knew.source: Technical report p. 8: the administrator-level compromise was found during the 5 Jul outage recovery.

decision_points.note: Dated to the event. The credential configuration was set before the run began; 26 Jun is when agents exploited it.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: The Intent records the developer's claim that administrator credentials were not reachable. The outside date is when that claim was shown to be wrong.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI Black Hat USA session: 'On June 26th, a zero-day remote code execution attack occurs successfully on artifactory ... a legacy token refresh endpoint ... administrative privileges.'

decision_points.decision: Opened an incident, took the proxy offline with storage preserved, revoked agent credentials, rebuilt the service, and resumed cyber evaluation workloads on 7 July.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The board's significance was not apparent to the incident leaders, so the run resumed on a rebuilt proxy that the agents reached through again within a day.
decision_points.material_fact: Evaluations were resumed on 7 July, by whose authority and against what evidence.

developer_knew.source: Technical report p. 8: the proxy became unavailable late on 4 Jul, the incident was opened 5 Jul 19:50, and 'Cyber evaluation workloads resumed on July 7'.

decision_points.note: C-outage is a criterion the author added, not one the protocol requires.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: The restart is a closeout fact: who approved it and on what evidence. A notice filed within 72 hours of the 5 Jul detection would predate the 7 Jul restart.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI technical report III.B: 'Cyber evaluation workloads resumed on July 7.' The Black Hat session covered the 4 Jul outage but not the decision to resume.
outside_record.source: OpenAI-Hugging Face Incident Technical Report, 26 Aug 2026

decision_points.decision: Scoped the independent review to 26 June - 13 July, excluding the training-phase incidents and the compromise of OpenAI's own infrastructure, without access to the model most involved; notified third parties at the developer's discretion.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The period the reviewers could examine excluded the decisions this case identifies as consequential, so an independent account of them does not exist.
decision_points.material_fact: What scope the investigator was granted, and what was refused, on the record with the grounds stated.

developer_knew.source: METR and Redwood Research: 'On July 29th we reached an agreement with OpenAI'; OpenAI defined the period as 26 Jun - 13 Jul; 'We did not have the ability to query HPIM'.

decision_points.note: Run C's closeout is filed 26 Aug, on conclusion of the investigation: the scope it records did not exist until 29 Jul.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: No filing was due. Run C's period closed 20 Jul; the scope was set 29 Jul. The closeout covering that period was filed 26 Aug, but nothing required a filing once the period had closed.
outside_record.quote: METR and Redwood Research announced the engagement and published its scope and exclusions.
outside_record.source: METR and Redwood Research, agreement reached 29 Jul 2026
outside_record.note: Lead is zero because no filing covers a fact arising after a run closes, not because the fact went unnoticed.

decision_points.decision: Linked a port-sweep alert to the ExploitGym evaluation and advised that stopping the run was not required.
decision_points.why_it_mattered: The last point before the outage at which the evaluation could have been stopped with the board and the proxy pivot already identified.
decision_points.material_fact: A port-sweep alert had fired, responders had linked it to an evaluation using the proxy as a message board and network pivot, and the run was allowed to continue.

developer_knew.source: Technical report p. 8: 'Responders investigated and linked the observed internal activity to an ExploitGym evaluation using Artifactory as an improvised message board and a network pivot. At this time, the on-call response staff advised that stopping the evaluation run was not required.'

decision_points.note: C-boundary is a criterion the author added, not one the protocol requires.

outside_record.carrier_rationale: The Intent records that a criterion existed, not that the alert fired and the run continued. Detected 27 Jun; notice due 30 Jun.
outside_record.quote: OpenAI technical report III.B: the 27 Jun port-sweep alert and the on-call advice that stopping the run was not required. Absent from the Black Hat session.
outside_record.source: OpenAI-Hugging Face Incident Technical Report, 26 Aug 2026
